body: Der Ferrari Roma steht bei uns in der Filiale, aber der Verkäufer hat die unterschriebene Freigabe für CD-420458 noch nicht zurückgeschickt.
Ich lasse die Abholung unbestätigt. Bitte senden Sie die unterschriebene Freigabe, bevor wir den Fahrer zur Übernahme schicken.
Car present is not authority to take it. No accepted release document is on the order.
Ich habe beim Verkäufer nachgefragt. Vielleicht kommt die Freigabe heute Nachmittag, versprechen kann ich es noch nicht.
The pickup contact says reception has the keys for CD-420516; the pickup note still tells the driver to use the side gate.
I will reconcile those instructions with the site before the offer goes live.
Ready vehicle, disputed handover path. Confirm desk and access hours; leave readiness intact while checking.
The selected collection slot is still fine. We only need the driver sent to the right person.
I am unwell this morning. I may not be fit to collect CD-420449 in the booked slot; I can confirm by early evening.
Thanks for letting us know. Please update us this evening; I'll look for cover in case you can't drive.
The driver has not cancelled. Keep the assignment visible and prepare a replacement option without double-booking.
I will update you before 18:00. Do not cancel the gig yet.
The queue before the terminal has barely moved. The booked crossing for CD-420603 may close before I reach check-in.
I am checking the check-in deadline and next available sailing. Please send your latest ETA when it updates.
Do not cancel the current booking or promise another crossing until capacity and fare terms are confirmed.
I am still in the queue with the car. I have not turned toward another terminal.
For CD-420437, the receiving contact in Munich is available only until early afternoon on the planned date.
That differs from the selected window. I will check the route and get a named handover contact before changing instructions.
Treat this as a proposed access constraint until the receiving contact confirms exact hours.
We can discuss another slot if the driver cannot make it safely.
Can you send the signed delivery proof for CD-420164? The car reached the receiving address, but the handover file is not in our inbox.
I can see submitted delivery photos. I will check whether the signed document was captured before saying the file is complete.
Do not treat submitted photos as an approved signed handover. Verify the document requirement and recipient.
The photos help, but accounting specifically needs the signed handover record.
The receiving contact says the Bentley Continental GT from CD-420055 arrived with a mark they did not expect. Can you check the handover photos?
Please send a photo of the mark and when the recipient first noticed it. I'll compare that with the pickup and delivery photos.
A condition claim is not an attributed damage finding. Preserve the original evidence and ask for the location and time of the observed mark.
The receiving partner has now sent two photos of the left rear mark. They cannot confirm when they first noticed it.
Thank you. We will review both sets of evidence and return with what can actually be established.
Can you confirm which purchase-order reference was attached to CD-420194? Our accounts team cannot match the delivery.
The order currently carries PO-005-0194. I will check whether the invoice uses that same reference before advising accounts.
Do not claim an invoice exists or that it was issued. The order reference and billing document are separate records.
That helps. Please tell us if the billing record needs a correction after you check.
I am following up on the release for CD-420458; the signer has not sent it yet.
Thanks. Collection is still unconfirmed until the signed release is attached and checked.
The key desk on CD-420516 is still unclear. Did the site contact confirm it?
Not yet. The selected window remains, but we will not send a driver to an unverified handover point.
I am still unsure whether I will be well enough to drive CD-420449.
Thanks for updating us. The assignment remains active while we prepare a backup and wait for your definite answer.
The receiving contact still cannot take CD-420437 after early afternoon. Is the driver on course?
I am checking the latest ETA and an authorized receiver. We have not changed the delivery promise yet.
Our accounts team is asking again for the signed handover on CD-420164.
The signed record is still missing from the order. I will follow up without representing photos as the signed document.
When will the car reach Frankfurt?
The selected delivery window is 21 Oct 10:00–16:00 (Europe/Berlin). That is not a live ETA; no precise arrival time is confirmed in this conversation.
Can you confirm the current collection window for CD-420384?
The selected collection window is 27 Oct 10:00–13:00 (Europe/Helsinki). That is the full planned slot, not a confirmed arrival minute.
Has the pickup time for CD-420585 been selected from the available window?
The selected collection window is 26 Oct 10:00–13:00 (Europe/Berlin). That is the full planned slot, not a confirmed arrival minute.
Should I tell the buyer a driver is confirmed for CD-420118?
No driver is booked on this order yet.
Is the handover file for CD-420020 ready for our records?

The driver app records delivery of CD-420020 at 19 Oct 14:00. The CMR on file records collection, but it has no receiver signature. Delivery photos were submitted but have not been reviewed. I will check what we can provide for your records.
Should I tell the buyer a driver is confirmed for CD-420537?
Yes, a driver accepted the assignment. The driver app records collection of CD-420537 at 20 Oct 10:30. That is a pickup record, not a delivery confirmation.
Can you confirm that CD-420111 reached the receiving address?
The order is marked delivered. I can check the handover evidence separately if you need it.
When will the car reach Tampere?
The selected delivery window is 26 Oct 12:00–16:00 (Europe/Helsinki). That is not a live ETA; no precise arrival time is confirmed in this conversation.
I am at Velantora Helsinki for CD-420593. Reception cannot find the BMW M4 in the handover list.
Please stay at the site for a moment. Can the desk check the vehicle record and the yard before you leave?
The car is not in our release queue. I can see a similar stock reference, but I cannot hand it over without confirmation.
A similar stock reference is not proof of identity. Keep the pickup event unset; ask the customer which site physically holds this VIN.
Our system still lists this branch. I am calling the stock team now; please do not substitute a different car.
We have paused collection while the site and customer reconcile the record. I will update the driver when the actual location and release authority are confirmed.
I can wait another 30 minutes. After that I need a new plan for my travel back.
I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
It is not booked. I am checking capacity against the pickup and delivery windows now.
The overnight sailing returned sold out. The later sailing has a quote only. Check driver rest and customer promise before purchase.
The overnight crossing is unavailable. I am checking an alternative and will confirm the revised plan before you start toward the terminal.
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
The later sailing can work for me if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. I have not changed my pickup time.
No ferry booking, hotel booking or changed customer promise exists yet. Prepare a reviewable plan with the cost and ETA difference.
I have stopped the Bentley Continental GT on CD-420322. A red warning came on and the car felt different when accelerating.
Thank you for stopping. Are you and the vehicle in a safe place? Please do not drive it further while we contact the owner.
I am safe at a service-area car park. The engine is off. I can send a dashboard photo, but I have not diagnosed the issue.
Human owner required. Record the safe stop, get the photo and call the customer for instructions. No recovery booking or delivery promise yet.
Please keep the vehicle stopped. I will ask our service contact whether it needs roadside assistance or collection.
We have paused the journey pending the owner's instruction. We will update the delivery estimate after the recovery plan is confirmed.
I will wait here. Please tell me who is collecting the car before anyone moves it.
The receiving team has noticed a mark on the rear panel of CD-420455. Can you tell us whether it was there at collection?
I will compare the pickup and delivery evidence and ask when the mark was first noticed. We cannot assign responsibility from this message alone.
The receiving branch reports a rear-panel mark. Do you recall it being mentioned at handover? Please describe what you observed, without changing the original photos.
I did not hear a condition concern at the desk. I cannot tell from memory whether the mark was visible at pickup.
Preserve the original pickup and delivery photos. Request timestamped branch photos and handover notes. No damage attribution or compensation decision yet.
I have asked the branch for a close photo and the time they first noticed it. Please wait for that before concluding anything.
For CD-420347: Our handover sheet names a vehicle yard, but the booking says to wait outside the showroom. Where should collection start?

For CD-420347: The booking says showroom handover, but the customer's sheet names a nearby vehicle yard. Can you verify where this car and its keys are before anyone travels? Please check this order, not the general site profile.

I can see the booking, but our collection screen says showroom handover and the handover sheet says the nearby yard. I cannot confirm where this car or its keys are. Stock control will check the vehicle record and call us back by 14:00 local time today. Please do not send a driver before we confirm the collection point.

For CD-420347, neither the car nor its keys have been located at the showroom or nearby yard. Stock control will call back by 14:00 local time. Please do not send anyone yet; the planned slot has not been changed.
The site reply did not establish a collection point. Keep the live market offer under review and do not turn either location into a confirmed instruction.
Earliest vehicle crossing returned sold out. A later crossing is only a quote. The assigned driver is based away from Marseille; positioning, rest and the customer promise still need a reviewed plan.
I can collect from Marseille tomorrow if my trip there is confirmed. Please send the actual travel booking, not just a suggested route.
We are checking the route and vehicle space. The pickup slot and delivery promise have not been changed. We will ask before proposing a later handover.
Please keep the agreed attended delivery window. If the route cannot make it, send the revised date and reason for approval before contacting the recipient at the home address.

Compare the available crossing with road time, driver rest, check-in and arrival at the private delivery address. Neither the crossing quote nor positioning quote is a purchase. Escalate if the promise needs revision and confirm the recipient separately.
Je dépasserai le créneau de réception initial. Je peux reprendre la route après la pause prévue, mais il me faut un nouvel horaire de remise avec quelqu'un sur place.

Le conducteur signale une arrivée après le créneau de réception initial et doit prendre sa pause prévue. Merci d'approuver un créneau de livraison plus tardif. Il faut aussi confirmer séparément la personne qui recevra la voiture à l'adresse privée.
J'approuve le créneau de livraison plus tardif. Veuillez confirmer directement que quelqu'un à l'adresse privée pourra recevoir la voiture et les clés.

Le client a approuvé le nouveau créneau de livraison. Il faut encore confirmer directement la personne qui recevra la voiture avant la remise. Conservez l'engagement initial et cet accord dans le dossier; ne laissez pas les clés sans surveillance.

Delivery was recorded within the revised window. The original promise was missed; the customer approved the new window before the original one expired. Retain both promises and the communication record.
Pour CD-420656, le véhicule ne sera pas libéré à la date prévue. Peut-on décaler l'enlèvement de deux jours ?
Le conducteur est déjà affecté. Je vais vérifier sa disponibilité, le créneau du site et les réservations liées avant de proposer une nouvelle date.
Le service de préparation attend encore une pièce. Je n'ai pas de date ferme de leur part.
Dans ce cas je signale un risque sur l'enlèvement, mais je ne remplace pas le créneau confirmé par une date incertaine.
Workshop cannot give a firm release date. Preserve booked slot as current state while planning searches replacement capacity.
The buyer withdrew and the Volvo V60 sale is cancelled. Please stop tomorrow's collection.
A driver is already assigned. Please confirm that you want us to stop this collection; we will review any documented driver cost separately.
Confirmed: cancel the collection. The car will stay with us.
The customer cancelled CD-420419. Do not travel to collection. We are reviewing whether you have any out-of-pocket cost.
Understood. I had not bought travel or left for Hamburg, so I have no cost to submit.

I am still on CD-420326, heading toward Hamburg. After that handover I need my rest. My first time to travel is after 12:00 tomorrow local time, so I cannot reach the selected Leipzig collection slot. I have no travel booking. Please check a replacement or ask the customer about another slot.

Driver reported no workable positioning to the selected Leipzig pickup after their active Hamburg duty. Previous-duty tracking is only an ETA. Confirm the driver constraint, then review replacement capacity or a customer-approved change. The assignment remains accepted.
I have stopped for the night. The car is locked and I have the keys. I will continue toward delivery in the morning.
Thanks. Please send your current location and a new arrival estimate when you resume.
I am taking my overnight rest now. The vehicle is locked, and its keys are still with me. I will send a fresh ETA tomorrow.
Thanks. Please send your current location and a new arrival estimate when you resume.
The pickup photos were rejected because two images show another car. Please retake this vehicle's registration and four sides.
The delivery photos do not identify the car or handover. Please add a clear car and receiving-location image.
Voisitteko vastaanottaa vaihtoauton jo tiistaina 20.10. klo 13–14? Alkuperäinen paluuaikapyyntö on torstaille; emme siirrä sitä ilman vahvistustanne.
Tiistai 20.10. käy. Vastaanotto on paikalla klo 13–14 ja ottaa auton sekä avaimet vastaan.
Vaihtoauto ja avaimet vastaanotettu klo 13.50. Vastaanotto kuittasi auton; luovutuskuvat voitte tarkistaa erikseen.
Can CD-420201 be collected this morning instead of next week and delivered tomorrow? The source branch told us the car is ready now.
The customer requests collection today at the existing branch, 09:00-11:00 local, and delivery tomorrow 10:00-15:00 local. Can you do both? Do not take the keys until the exact vehicle is identified.
I can collect in that slot and deliver tomorrow if the car is there.
Yes, use 09:00-11:00 local time today at the existing Munich branch and 10:00-15:00 local tomorrow for delivery. The seller told us the car could be released this morning.
I am at the agreed reception desk. Staff cannot find the car matching CD-420201. I have not taken keys or moved a vehicle.
We checked our release list and the yard with the driver. We cannot locate the vehicle on this order and will not release another car.
The driver is at the branch. Branch staff confirm they cannot locate the specified vehicle, and nothing was collected. Would you like us to wait for a new verified location or cancel this transport?
Cancel CD-420201. We will investigate where the car is and make a new request if it is found. Please release the driver.
The customer cancelled the order. Please leave the site; do not collect another vehicle. You may submit a documented out-of-pocket cost for review.
I paid 12 EUR for parking while waiting at the branch. I have submitted the receipt; please review it.
I have not reached the Espoo transfer yard. I cannot get there before its 11:00 local staffed release cutoff; please do not leave the car waiting for me.
The staffed 09:00-11:00 release window has ended. No collector checked in for this car, and the car and keys remain on our yard register. We have not released them to the booked driver.
The car and keys are still with our staffed yard. We can release them to a replacement driver tomorrow, 22 October, between 09:00 and 11:00 local time after an ID and condition check.

The first driver handed the car and keys to the staffed yard, but the second driver did not collect it. The yard can release it tomorrow morning. Your current delivery window cannot be met. Please confirm a new acceptable delivery target; we have not changed it in the order.
I am stopping for rest before the remaining drive to the terminal. The vehicle is with me. I will check the route again in the morning; I have not reached check-in.
Understood. Keep the car secure and update us before continuing. We have no independent location or check-in record yet.
The hotel offered to park the car and keep its key until morning. I have not handed the key over. Is that allowed before the ferry?
Please keep the key with you for now. We need the vehicle owner's approval before any third party takes custody. Tell us if you need another parking arrangement.

I understand the receiving contact is unavailable over the weekend. I have the vehicle locked and its keys with me. I plan to request an attended handover on Monday; I have not sent a parking location.
Thanks. Please send your current location and confirm the vehicle remains secure. We will check the Monday receiving appointment separately from the ferry booking status.

I accepted the two Golf job, CD-420413 then CD-420384. The first car ends at the same Tampere branch where the second begins the next day. Am I meant to collect the second set of keys on Monday and keep the car overnight?

No overnight custody has been agreed. The accepted offer covers both paid legs, but it does not authorize taking the second car a day early or leaving it unattended. We must confirm the branch release time and your Tuesday return plan first.
Understood. I will only collect the first Golf on Monday. Please tell me who confirms Tuesday's keys and where I should report.

The intake names Wilfred as the Helsinki recipient, but we have a different recipient reported. Who may sign and take the keys for this order? Please confirm the person and role before we update the driver instruction.
For this delivery I authorize Lena Alderbrook, our receiving lead, to inspect the car, sign the handover and take the keys. Wilfred is away and should not be used as the recipient.

I am Lena Alderbrook, the receiving lead for this delivery. I will be at the recorded Helsinki address and can sign for the vehicle and take the keys. Please ask the driver to call me on arrival; I will meet them at the door.
I could take CD-420404 if the fee were EUR 190. I have not booked it. Can you check before the offer closes?
The earlier booking window has closed. Your EUR 190 request is with dispatch, but no fee or gig is agreed. We will reply after the team decides.

The old EUR 161 offer is withdrawn after its booking cutoff. Approve a new open offer at EUR 179, not the requested EUR 190. The pickup slot still needs to be met; do not assign the driver from this email.
Dispatch has published a new open offer at EUR 179. Your EUR 190 request was not approved. Nothing is reserved for you; the live offer must be booked in the app.
Tämä on ensimmäinen kuljetuksemme. Onko CD-421010 jo kuljettajan vastuulla?
Ei vielä. Suunnitelma on aktiivinen, mutta tilausta ei ole julkaistu kuljettajille eikä noutoa ole kirjattu.
Selvä. Odotamme varaustietoa ennen kuin valmistelemme luovutuksen.
For CD-420015, our order form names Elena Alderbrook, but the branch has not confirmed that contact will release the keys. Can you check?
Sorry this took until today. We are checking the order-specific release contact. This reply does not confirm that the branch has approved handover.
We still have no name from the branch. Please tell us who is checking it before anyone travels.
I have taken this over from support and will call the branch. Keep the existing collection instruction in place until the contact is confirmed.
Readiness owns the direct branch check now. The customer's repeated request and our delayed first reply do not verify a release contact or change the collection plan.

For Thursday we see CD-420154 and CD-420689 in the same collection window. Our release desk needs the driver and document set for each vehicle separately. Friday's CD-420656 and CD-420692 are a separate handover queue; please do not roll Thursday's release instruction forward.

CD-420154 has a booked driver; CD-420689 still has a live offer and no booking. We will verify the import documents and named driver for 154 first, then confirm each vehicle's release separately. Please hold the keys against their own references.

The site's message is a request for separate release instructions, not evidence that the import is cleared or that the domestic market job has a driver. Check 154's travel and release authority; keep 689's live offer and Friday's booked/ready pair distinct when planning site contact.

We received the returned trade-in for CD-420177 yesterday. CD-420941 is listed for Friday collection and CD-420413 for Monday. Please send the vehicle references and key contacts separately; the returned car is not one of those outbound releases.

Thank you. We will check the Friday vehicle identity and collection authority for CD-420941 before assigning a driver. The Monday bundle driver for CD-420413 will receive only that car's release instruction after the site confirms it.

The 177 trade-in has a recorded delivery to this site; that historical receipt does not authorize a new release. The 941 job has no driver yet, while 413 is booked as the first bundle leg. Verify vehicle and key custody per reference; do not use the bundle booking as authority for Friday's car.

The Düsseldorf pickup for CD-420735 is recorded. Before we use your Frankfurt collection for CD-420992 tomorrow, please confirm where you finish today's handover and when you can take the next keys. CD-420579 is a later Monday duty and does not establish your current location.

The 735 pickup is recorded, but delivery and release are not. Tomorrow's 992 pickup is in Frankfurt, the planned delivery city of 735; proximity is a route plan, not a verified driver position. Obtain today's actual handover and tomorrow's start confirmation before assuring the buyer. Keep Monday's 579 booking in the later duty view.
No driver response has arrived in this case. The next pickup remains booked, with the prior-duty release and positioning check open. Do not mark today's car delivered from the route endpoint alone.
The destination is in another time zone. Which local delivery range should they use?
The range in the destination time zone is 21 Oct 12:00–16:00 local.
Does a delivery target mean the vehicle has left the pickup site?
No. The target window is planning information; pickup needs its own recorded event.
Can you reserve a collector for CD-420009? The vehicle details are still with our seller.
I can keep the request in intake. Please send the vehicle identity before we offer the work to a driver.
Identity is still missing from the order. Intake owns the next check; the customer's request is not a booking.
I corrected the charging claim on CD-420326. The old submission still appears in my history. Will both be paid?
The earlier entry is superseded. The current submission is awaiting review; neither entry is evidence of payment.
There is also a parking claim from this trip. Please keep that separate from the charging correction.
Expenses takes both review questions from driver support. Check each submitted cost independently.
Both current claims remain under review. We will give separate decisions for parking and charging.
Our buyer sees the prepared CMR for the Cologne to Odense car. Can they treat that as signed?
No. The CMR is prepared for the trip. Signatures belong to the actual handovers, which have not happened on this order.
Understood. Please leave the file as prepared until the driver has the physical signatures.
That is the current document state. I have not changed it from this conversation.
Driver called from CD-420326 and says they need rest before another pickup. They won't reach the Leipzig slot on CD-420399. I don't see any positioning ticket booked. Who can cover that slot?

Keep the accepted assignment on CD-420399 while we check replacement capacity. Please prepare a buyer update that says collection timing is under review, without naming the driver's earlier customer's trip. No changed slot has been agreed.

Operations has a human coordinator on this. Please keep the vehicle stopped and send the service-area name or a safe location pin when you can. We are waiting for the owner's service instruction; nobody has cleared onward driving.

I checked vehicle SYNHU89YZ8GSW6CKB against the release list when it left our desk. The driver photographed the neighbouring car first. I can confirm which car left, but I did not take condition photos for you.
I am already away from the pickup branch with this car. I can take new vehicle photos at the next safe stop, but they would not show its pickup condition.

Site confirms the vehicle identity at release, not the condition image set. Keep pickup proof REJECTED. Ask for safe-stop photos as current condition only, and review delivery evidence separately. No retrospective pickup approval.
I am not available to take the Helsinki delivery myself. Our receiving lead may cover, but I need the buyer to authorize who can inspect and sign before you change the driver instruction.
Correction to my earlier message: the delivery address can be accessed until 18:00 local today. I still cannot confirm who is authorized to inspect and sign for the car.
The later access time may fit the current arrival estimate. I will not tell the driver to hand over the car or keys until you identify an authorized receiver who can attend.
Navigation says twenty minutes to the vehicle gate for CD-420342. The cutoff looks comfortable from here.

The gate rejected the manifest entry, although you reached it before cutoff. We are correcting the car registration with the carrier. Please wait for the gate's new result; this is not a boarding confirmation.
The corrected manifest was accepted at the vehicle gate. Keep the booking reference; we still need boarding and arrival evidence separately.

Carrier desk took our request to move this car to a later crossing, but has not confirmed a slot or fare. Keep the original booking active. Do not tell the driver to turn away or change the customer's delivery promise yet.

Reception does not have the keys for this car. The side gate is only for vehicle entry, not a collection desk. Our stock screen lists a warehouse transfer but no named person to release the vehicle. I cannot confirm the handover point or key holder for the selected slot; please hold a driver until stock control checks this car.

The site checked this car: reception has no key and the side gate is not a handover desk. Stock control is finding the key holder. The selected slot is still recorded, but collection is not confirmed and we are holding driver dispatch.

The car is at our branch, but the seller has withdrawn permission to hand it over while the invoice remains unsettled. We have no signed release for this vehicle. Do not send a driver even if the old collection note is still visible; our desk will refuse the handover until the seller clears the hold and sends a signed authority.

The branch has confirmed that the car is present, but the seller has placed a release hold and the signed vehicle-specific authority is still missing. We are keeping collection blocked. Please resolve the seller hold and send the signed release; we will verify both with the branch before scheduling a driver.
